verses.original: Ἐν ἐκείνῳ τῷ καιρῷ ἐπορεύθη ὁ Ἰησοῦς τοῖς σάββασιν διὰ τῶν σπορίμων οἱ δὲ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπείνασαν καὶ ἤρξαντο τίλλειν στάχυας καὶ ἐσθίειν
verses.transliteration: En ekeinō tō kairō eporeuthē ho Iēsous tois sabbasin dia tōn sporimōn hoi de mathētai autou epeinasan kai ērxanto tillein stachyas kai esthiein
verses.literal: At that time Jesus went through the grainfields on the Sabbath His disciples were hungry and began to pick the heads of grain and eat them
verses.literalPt: NAQUELE tempo passou Jesus pelas searas, em um sábado; e os seus discípulos, tendo fome, começaram a colher espigas, e a comer.

verses.original: οἱ δὲ Φαρισαῖοι ἰδόντες εἶπαν αὐτῷ Ἰδοὺ οἱ μαθηταί σου ποιοῦσιν ὃ οὐκ ἔξεστιν ποιεῖν ἐν σαββάτῳ
verses.transliteration: hoi de Pharisaioi idontes eipan autō Idou hoi mathētai sou poiousin ho ouk exestin poiein en sabbatō
verses.literal: When the Pharisees saw this they said to Him Look Your disciples are doing what is unlawful . . . on the Sabbath
verses.literalPt: E os fariseus, vendo isto, disseram-lhe: Eis que os teus discípulos fazem o que não é lícito fazer num sábado.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Οὐκ ἀνέγνωτε τί ἐποίησεν Δαυὶδ ὅτε ἐπείνασεν καὶ οἱ μετ’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ho de eipen autois Ouk anegnōte ti epoiēsen Dauid hote epeinasen kai hoi met’ autou
verses.literal: Jesus replied Have you not read what David did when he and his companions . . . . . . were hungry
verses.literalPt: Ele, porém, lhes disse: Não tendes lido o que fez Davi, quando teve fome, ele e os que com ele estavam?

verses.original: πῶς εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ τοὺς ἄρτους τῆς προθέσεως ἔφαγον ὃ οὐκ ἐξὸν ἦν αὐτῷ φαγεῖν οὐδὲ τοῖς μετ’ αὐτοῦ εἰ μὴ τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν μόνοις
verses.transliteration: pōs eisēlthen eis ton oikon tou Theou kai tous artous tēs protheseōs ephagon ho ouk exon ēn autō phagein oude tois met’ autou ei mē tois hiereusin monois
verses.literal: He entered . . . the house of God and he and his companions ate the consecrated bread . . . . . . which was not lawful for them . . . . . . . . . . . . to eat but . . . only for the priests
verses.literalPt: Como entrou na casa de Deus, e comeu os pães da proposição, que não lhe era lícito comer, nem aos que com ele estavam, mas só aos sacerdotes?

verses.original: Ἢ οὐκ ἀνέγνωτε ἐν τῷ νόμῳ ὅτι τοῖς σάββασιν οἱ ἱερεῖς ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ τὸ σάββατον βεβηλοῦσιν καὶ ἀναίτιοί εἰσιν
verses.transliteration: Ē ouk anegnōte en tō nomō hoti tois sabbasin hoi hiereis en tō hierō to sabbaton bebēlousin kai anaitioi eisin
verses.literal: Or haven’t you read in the Law that on the Sabbath the priests in the temple break the Sabbath and yet are innocent
verses.literalPt: Ou não tendes lido na lei que, aos sábados, os sacerdotes no templo violam o sábado, e ficam sem culpa?

verses.original: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν ὅτι τοῦ ἱεροῦ μεῖζόν ἐστιν ὧδε
verses.transliteration: legō de hymin hoti tou hierou meizon estin hōde
verses.literal: But I tell you that One greater than the temple is here
verses.literalPt: Pois eu vos digo que está aqui quem é maior do que o templo.

verses.original: Εἰ δὲ ἐγνώκειτε τί ἐστιν Ἔλεος θέλω καὶ οὐ θυσίαν οὐκ ἂν κατεδικάσατε τοὺς ἀναιτίους
verses.transliteration: Ei de egnōkeite ti estin Eleos thelō kai ou thysian ouk an katedikasate tous anaitious
verses.literal: If only you had known the meaning of I desire mercy not sacrifice you would not have condemned the innocent
verses.literalPt: Mas, se vós soubésseis o que significa: Misericórdia quero, e não sacrifício, não condenaríeis os inocentes.

verses.original: κύριος γάρ ἐστιν τοῦ σαββάτου ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου
verses.transliteration: kyrios gar estin tou sabbatou ho Huios tou anthrōpou
verses.literal: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath
verses.literalPt: Porque o Filho do homem até do sábado é Senhor.

verses.original: Καὶ μεταβὰς ἐκεῖθεν ἦλθεν εἰς τὴν συναγωγὴν αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai metabas ekeithen ēlthen eis tēn synagōgēn autōn
verses.literal: Moving on from there Jesus entered . . . their synagogue
verses.literalPt: E, partindo dali, chegou à sinagoga deles.

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄνθρωπος χεῖρα ἔχων ξηράν καὶ ἐπηρώτησαν αὐτὸν λέγοντες Εἰ ἔξεστιν τοῖς σάββασιν θεραπεῦσαι ἵνα κατηγορήσωσιν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai idou anthrōpos cheira echōn xēran kai epērōtēsan auton legontes Ei exestin tois sabbasin therapeusai hina katēgorēsōsin autou
verses.literal: and a man with a withered hand was there In order to accuse Jesus they asked Him Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath
verses.literalPt: E, estava ali um homem que tinha uma das mãos mirrada; e eles, para o acusarem, o interrogaram, dizendo: É lícito curar nos sábados?

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Τίς ἔσται ἐξ ὑμῶν ἄνθρωπος ὃς ἕξει πρόβατον ἕν καὶ ἐὰν ἐμπέσῃ τοῦτο τοῖς σάββασιν εἰς βόθυνον οὐχὶ κρατήσει αὐτὸ καὶ ἐγερεῖ
verses.transliteration: Ho de eipen autois Tis estai ex hymōn anthrōpos hos hexei probaton hen kai ean empesē touto tois sabbasin eis bothynon ouchi kratēsei auto kai egerei
verses.literal: He replied . . . If one of you has a sheep and it falls into a pit on the Sabbath will he not take hold of it and lift it out
verses.literalPt: E ele lhes disse: Qual dentre vós será o homem que tendo uma ovelha, se num sábado ela cair numa cova, não lançará mão dela, e a levantará?

verses.original: πόσῳ οὖν διαφέρει ἄνθρωπος προβάτου ὥστε ἔξεστιν τοῖς σάββασιν καλῶς ποιεῖν
verses.transliteration: posō oun diapherei anthrōpos probatou hōste exestin tois sabbasin kalōs poiein
verses.literal: How much more valuable is a man than a sheep Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath
verses.literalPt: Pois, quanto mais vale um homem do que uma ovelha? É, por conseqüência, lícito fazer bem nos sábados.

verses.original: Τότε λέγει τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ Ἔκτεινόν σου τὴν χεῖρα καὶ ἐξέτεινεν καὶ ἀπεκατεστάθη ὑγιὴς ὡς ἡ ἄλλη
verses.transliteration: Tote legei tō anthrōpō Ekteinon sou tēn cheira kai exeteinen kai apekatestathē hygiēs hōs hē allē
verses.literal: Then Jesus said to the man Stretch out your hand So he stretched it out and it was restored to full use just like the other
verses.literalPt: Então disse àquele homem: Estende a tua mão. E ele a estendeu, e ficou sã como a outra.

verses.original: ἐξελθόντες δὲ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι συμβούλιον ἔλαβον κατ’ αὐτοῦ ὅπως αὐτὸν ἀπολέσωσιν
verses.transliteration: exelthontes de hoi Pharisaioi symboulion elabon kat’ autou hopōs auton apolesōsin
verses.literal: But the Pharisees went out and plotted . . . - how they might kill Jesus
verses.literalPt: E os fariseus, tendo saído, formaram conselho contra ele, para o matarem.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς γνοὺς ἀνεχώρησεν ἐκεῖθεν καὶ ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ ὄχλοι πολλοί καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν αὐτοὺς πάντας
verses.transliteration: Ho de Iēsous gnous anechōrēsen ekeithen kai ēkolouthēsan autō ochloi polloi kai etherapeusen autous pantas
verses.literal: Aware of this - Jesus withdrew from that place Large crowds followed Him and He healed them all
verses.literalPt: Jesus, sabendo isso, retirou-se dali, e acompanharam-no grandes multidões, e ele curou a todas.

verses.original: καὶ ἐπετίμησεν αὐτοῖς ἵνα μὴ φανερὸν αὐτὸν ποιήσωσιν
verses.transliteration: kai epetimēsen autois hina mē phaneron auton poiēsōsin
verses.literal: warning them not to make Him known
verses.literalPt: E recomendava-lhes rigorosamente que o não descobrissem,

verses.original: ἵνα πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ Ἠσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος
verses.transliteration: hina plērōthē to rhēthen dia Ēsaiou tou prophētou legontos
verses.literal: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah
verses.literalPt: Para que se cumprisse o que fora dito pelo profeta Isaías, que diz:

verses.original: Ἰδοὺ ὁ παῖς μου ὃν ᾑρέτισα ὁ ἀγαπητός μου εἰς ὃν εὐδόκησεν ἡ ψυχή μου θήσω τὸ Πνεῦμά μου ἐπ’ αὐτόν καὶ κρίσιν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἀπαγγελεῖ
verses.transliteration: Idou ho pais mou hon hēretisa ho agapētos mou eis hon eudokēsen hē psychē mou thēsō to Pneuma mou ep’ auton kai krisin tois ethnesin apangelei
verses.literal: Here is My Servant whom I have chosen My beloved in whom My soul delights I will put My Spirit on Him and He will proclaim justice to the nations
verses.literalPt: Eis aqui o meu servo, que escolhi, O meu amado, em quem a minha alma se compraz; Porei sobre ele o meu espírito, E anunciará aos gentios o juízo.

verses.original: οὐκ ἐρίσει οὐδὲ κραυγάσει οὐδὲ ἀκούσει τις ἐν ταῖς πλατείαις τὴν φωνὴν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: ouk erisei oude kraugasei oude akousei tis en tais plateiais tēn phōnēn autou
verses.literal: He will not quarrel or cry out no one will hear His voice in the streets
verses.literalPt: Não contenderá, nem clamará, Nem alguém ouvirá pelas ruas a sua voz;

verses.original: κάλαμον συντετριμμένον οὐ κατεάξει καὶ λίνον τυφόμενον οὐ σβέσει ἕως ἂν ἐκβάλῃ εἰς νῖκος τὴν κρίσιν
verses.transliteration: kalamon syntetrimmenon ou kateaxei kai linon typhomenon ou sbesei heōs an ekbalē eis nikos tēn krisin
verses.literal: A bruised reed He will not break and a smoldering wick He will not extinguish till . . . He leads justice to victory
verses.literalPt: Não esmagará a cana quebrada, E não apagará o morrão que fumega, Até que faça triunfar o juízo;

verses.original: καὶ τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ ἔθνη ἐλπιοῦσιν
verses.transliteration: kai tō onomati autou ethnē elpiousin
verses.literal: In His name the nations will put their hope
verses.literalPt: E no seu nome os gentios esperarão.

verses.original: Τότε προσηνέχθη αὐτῷ δαιμονιζόμενος τυφλὸς καὶ κωφός καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν αὐτόν ὥστε τὸν κωφὸν λαλεῖν καὶ βλέπειν
verses.transliteration: Tote prosēnechthē autō daimonizomenos typhlos kai kōphos kai etherapeusen auton hōste ton kōphon lalein kai blepein
verses.literal: Then a demon-possessed man who was blind and mute was brought to Jesus and He healed the man so that he could speak and see
verses.literalPt: Trouxeram-lhe, então, um endemoninhado cego e mudo; e, de tal modo o curou, que o cego e mudo falava e via.

verses.original: καὶ ἐξίσταντο πάντες οἱ ὄχλοι καὶ ἔλεγον Μήτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ υἱὸς Δαυίδ
verses.transliteration: kai existanto pantes hoi ochloi kai elegon Mēti houtos estin ho huios Dauid
verses.literal: The crowds were astounded and asked Could this be . . . . . . the Son of David
verses.literalPt: E toda a multidão se admirava e dizia: Não é este o Filho de Davi?

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ Φαρισαῖοι ἀκούσαντες εἶπον Οὗτος οὐκ ἐκβάλλει τὰ δαιμόνια εἰ μὴ ἐν τῷ Βεελζεβοὺλ ἄρχοντι τῶν δαιμονίων
verses.transliteration: Hoi de Pharisaioi akousantes eipon Houtos ouk ekballei ta daimonia ei mē en tō Beelzeboul archonti tōn daimoniōn
verses.literal: But when the Pharisees heard this they said Only . . . by Beelzebul the prince of demons does this man drive out demons
verses.literalPt: Mas os fariseus, ouvindo isto, diziam: Este não expulsa os demônios senão por Belzebu, príncipe dos demônios.

verses.original: Εἰδὼς δὲ τὰς ἐνθυμήσεις αὐτῶν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Πᾶσα βασιλεία μερισθεῖσα καθ’ ἑαυτῆς ἐρημοῦται καὶ πᾶσα πόλις ἢ οἰκία μερισθεῖσα καθ’ ἑαυτῆς οὐ σταθήσεται
verses.transliteration: Eidōs de tas enthymēseis autōn eipen autois Pasa basileia meristheisa kath’ heautēs erēmoutai kai pasa polis ē oikia meristheisa kath’ heautēs ou stathēsetai
verses.literal: Knowing their thoughts Jesus said to them Every kingdom divided against itself will be laid waste and every city or household divided against itself will not stand
verses.literalPt: Jesus, porém, conhecendo os seus pensamentos, disse-lhes: Todo o reino dividido contra si mesmo é devastado; e toda a cidade, ou casa, dividida contra si mesma não subsistirá.

verses.original: καὶ εἰ ὁ Σατανᾶς τὸν Σατανᾶν ἐκβάλλει ἐφ’ ἑαυτὸν ἐμερίσθη πῶς οὖν σταθήσεται ἡ βασιλεία αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai ei ho Satanas ton Satanan ekballei eph’ heauton emeristhē pōs oun stathēsetai hē basileia autou
verses.literal: If Satan drives out Satan he is divided against himself How then can his kingdom stand
verses.literalPt: E, se Satanás expulsa a Satanás, está dividido contra si mesmo; como subsistirá, pois, o seu reino?

verses.original: Καὶ εἰ ἐγὼ ἐν Βεελζεβοὺλ ἐκβάλλω τὰ δαιμόνια οἱ υἱοὶ ὑμῶν ἐν τίνι ἐκβάλλουσιν διὰ τοῦτο αὐτοὶ κριταὶ ἔσονται ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai ei egō en Beelzeboul ekballō ta daimonia hoi huioi hymōn en tini ekballousin dia touto autoi kritai esontai hymōn
verses.literal: And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul by whom do your sons drive them out So then . . . they will be your judges
verses.literalPt: E, se eu expulso os demônios por Belzebu, por quem os expulsam então vossos filhos? Portanto, eles mesmos serão os vossos juízes.

verses.original: εἰ δὲ ἐν Πνεύματι Θεοῦ ἐγὼ ἐκβάλλω τὰ δαιμόνια ἄρα ἔφθασεν ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: ei de en Pneumati Theou egō ekballō ta daimonia ara ephthasen eph’ hymas hē basileia tou Theou
verses.literal: But if I drive out demons by the Spirit of God then the kingdom of God has come upon you
verses.literalPt: Mas, se eu expulso os demônios pelo Espírito de Deus, logo é chegado a vós o reino de Deus.

verses.original: Ἢ πῶς δύναταί τις εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν τοῦ ἰσχυροῦ καὶ τὰ σκεύη αὐτοῦ ἁρπάσαι ἐὰν μὴ πρῶτον δήσῃ τὸν ἰσχυρόν καὶ τότε τὴν οἰκίαν αὐτοῦ διαρπάσει
verses.transliteration: Ē pōs dynatai tis eiselthein eis tēn oikian tou ischyrou kai ta skeuē autou harpasai ean mē prōton dēsē ton ischyron kai tote tēn oikian autou diarpasei
verses.literal: Or again how can anyone enter . . . a strong man’s house and steal his possessions unless . . . he first ties up the strong man Then he can plunder his house
verses.literalPt: Ou, como pode alguém entrar em casa do homem valente, e furtar os seus bens, se primeiro não maniatar o valente, saqueando então a sua casa?

verses.original: Ὁ μὴ ὢν μετ’ ἐμοῦ κατ’ ἐμοῦ ἐστιν καὶ ὁ μὴ συνάγων μετ’ ἐμοῦ σκορπίζει
verses.transliteration: Ho mē ōn met’ emou kat’ emou estin kai ho mē synagōn met’ emou skorpizei
verses.literal: He who is not with Me is against Me and he who does not gather with Me scatters
verses.literalPt: Quem não é comigo é contra mim; e quem comigo não ajunta, espalha.

verses.original: Διὰ τοῦτο λέγω ὑμῖν πᾶσα ἁμαρτία καὶ βλασφημία ἀφεθήσεται τοῖς ἀνθρώποις ἡ δὲ τοῦ Πνεύματος βλασφημία οὐκ ἀφεθήσεται
verses.transliteration: Dia touto legō hymin pasa hamartia kai blasphēmia aphethēsetai tois anthrōpois hē de tou Pneumatos blasphēmia ouk aphethēsetai
verses.literal: Therefore . . . I tell you every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven
verses.literalPt: Portanto, eu vos digo: Todo o pecado e blasfêmia se perdoará aos homens; mas a blasfêmia contra o Espírito não será perdoada aos homens.

verses.original: καὶ ὃς ἐὰν εἴπῃ λόγον κατὰ τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἀφεθήσεται αὐτῷ ὃς δ’ ἂν εἴπῃ κατὰ τοῦ Πνεύματος τοῦ Ἁγίου οὐκ ἀφεθήσεται αὐτῷ οὔτε ἐν τούτῳ τῷ αἰῶνι οὔτε ἐν τῷ μέλλοντι
verses.transliteration: kai hos ean eipē logon kata tou Huiou tou anthrōpou aphethēsetai autō hos d’ an eipē kata tou Pneumatos tou Hagiou ouk aphethēsetai autō oute en toutō tō aiōni oute en tō mellonti
verses.literal: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven . . . but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven . . . either in this age or in the one to come
verses.literalPt: E, se qualquer disser alguma palavra contra o Filho do homem, ser-lhe-á perdoado; mas, se alguém falar contra o Espírito Santo, não lhe será perdoado, nem neste século nem no futuro.

verses.original: Ἢ ποιήσατε τὸ δένδρον καλὸν καὶ τὸν καρπὸν αὐτοῦ καλόν ἢ ποιήσατε τὸ δένδρον σαπρὸν καὶ τὸν καρπὸν αὐτοῦ σαπρόν ἐκ γὰρ τοῦ καρποῦ τὸ δένδρον γινώσκεται
verses.transliteration: Ē poiēsate to dendron kalon kai ton karpon autou kalon ē poiēsate to dendron sapron kai ton karpon autou sapron ek gar tou karpou to dendron ginōsketai
verses.literal: Make a tree good and its fruit will be good or make a tree bad and its fruit will be bad for a tree is known by its fruit
verses.literalPt: Ou fazei a árvore boa, e o seu fruto bom, ou fazei a árvore má, e o seu fruto mau; porque pelo fruto se conhece a árvore.

verses.original: γεννήματα ἐχιδνῶν πῶς δύνασθε ἀγαθὰ λαλεῖν πονηροὶ ὄντες ἐκ γὰρ τοῦ περισσεύματος τῆς καρδίας τὸ στόμα λαλεῖ
verses.transliteration: gennēmata echidnōn pōs dynasthe agatha lalein ponēroi ontes ek gar tou perisseumatos tēs kardias to stoma lalei
verses.literal: You brood of vipers how can you who are evil say anything good For out of the overflow of the heart the mouth speaks
verses.literalPt: Raça de víboras, como podeis vós dizer boas coisas, sendo maus? Pois do que há em abundância no coração, disso fala a boca.

verses.original: ὁ ἀγαθὸς ἄνθρωπος ἐκ τοῦ ἀγαθοῦ θησαυροῦ ἐκβάλλει ἀγαθά καὶ ὁ πονηρὸς ἄνθρωπος ἐκ τοῦ πονηροῦ θησαυροῦ ἐκβάλλει πονηρά
verses.transliteration: ho agathos anthrōpos ek tou agathou thēsaurou ekballei agatha kai ho ponēros anthrōpos ek tou ponērou thēsaurou ekballei ponēra
verses.literal: The good man brings good things out of his good store of treasure and the evil man brings evil things out of his evil store of treasure
verses.literalPt: O homem bom tira boas coisas do bom tesouro do seu coração, e o homem mau do mau tesouro tira coisas más.

verses.original: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν ὅτι πᾶν ῥῆμα ἀργὸν ὃ λαλήσουσιν οἱ ἄνθρωποι ἀποδώσουσιν περὶ αὐτοῦ λόγον ἐν ἡμέρᾳ κρίσεως
verses.transliteration: legō de hymin hoti pan rhēma argon ho lalēsousin hoi anthrōpoi apodōsousin peri autou logon en hēmera kriseōs
verses.literal: But I tell you that men will give an account - on the day of judgment for every careless word they have spoken
verses.literalPt: Mas eu vos digo que de toda a palavra ociosa que os homens disserem hão de dar conta no dia do juízo.

verses.original: ἐκ γὰρ τῶν λόγων σου δικαιωθήσῃ καὶ ἐκ τῶν λόγων σου καταδικασθήσῃ
verses.transliteration: ek gar tōn logōn sou dikaiōthēsē kai ek tōn logōn sou katadikasthēsē
verses.literal: For by your words you will be acquitted and by your words you will be condemned
verses.literalPt: Porque por tuas palavras serás justificado, e por tuas palavras serás condenado.

verses.original: Τότε ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτῷ τινες τῶν γραμματέων καὶ Φαρισαίων λέγοντες Διδάσκαλε θέλομεν ἀπὸ σοῦ σημεῖον ἰδεῖν
verses.transliteration: Tote apekrithēsan autō tines tōn grammateōn kai Pharisaiōn legontes Didaskale thelomen apo sou sēmeion idein
verses.literal: Then some of the scribes and Pharisees said to Him . . . . . . Teacher we want to see a sign from You
verses.literalPt: Então alguns dos escribas e dos fariseus tomaram a palavra, dizendo: Mestre, quiséramos ver da tua parte algum sinal.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Γενεὰ πονηρὰ καὶ μοιχαλὶς σημεῖον ἐπιζητεῖ καὶ σημεῖον οὐ δοθήσεται αὐτῇ εἰ μὴ τὸ σημεῖον Ἰωνᾶ τοῦ προφήτου
verses.transliteration: Ho de apokritheis eipen autois Genea ponēra kai moichalis sēmeion epizētei kai sēmeion ou dothēsetai autē ei mē to sēmeion Iōna tou prophētou
verses.literal: Jesus replied - A wicked and adulterous generation demands a sign but none . . . will be given it except . . . the sign of the prophet Jonah
verses.literalPt: Mas ele lhes respondeu, e disse: Uma geração má e adúltera pede um sinal, porém, não se lhe dará outro sinal senão o do profeta Jonas;

verses.original: ὥσπερ γὰρ ἦν Ἰωνᾶς ἐν τῇ κοιλίᾳ τοῦ κήτους τρεῖς ἡμέρας καὶ τρεῖς νύκτας οὕτως ἔσται ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ τῆς γῆς τρεῖς ἡμέρας καὶ τρεῖς νύκτας
verses.transliteration: hōsper gar ēn Iōnas en tē koilia tou kētous treis hēmeras kai treis nyktas houtōs estai ho Huios tou anthrōpou en tē kardia tēs gēs treis hēmeras kai treis nyktas
verses.literal: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the great fish so the Son of Man will be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth
verses.literalPt: Pois, como Jonas esteve três dias e três noites no ventre da baleia, assim estará o Filho do homem três dias e três noites no seio da terra.

verses.original: Ἄνδρες Νινευῖται ἀναστήσονται ἐν τῇ κρίσει μετὰ τῆς γενεᾶς ταύτης καὶ κατακρινοῦσιν αὐτήν ὅτι μετενόησαν εἰς τὸ κήρυγμα Ἰωνᾶ καὶ ἰδοὺ πλεῖον Ἰωνᾶ ὧδε
verses.transliteration: Andres Nineuitai anastēsontai en tē krisei meta tēs geneas tautēs kai katakrinousin autēn hoti metenoēsan eis to kērygma Iōna kai idou pleion Iōna hōde
verses.literal: The men of Nineveh will stand at the judgment with this generation and condemn it for they repented at the preaching of Jonah and now One greater than Jonah is here
verses.literalPt: Os ninivitas ressurgirão no juízo com esta geração, e a condenarão, porque se arrependeram com a pregação de Jonas. E eis que está aqui quem é mais do que Jonas.

verses.original: βασίλισσα νότου ἐγερθήσεται ἐν τῇ κρίσει μετὰ τῆς γενεᾶς ταύτης καὶ κατακρινεῖ αὐτήν ὅτι ἦλθεν ἐκ τῶν περάτων τῆς γῆς ἀκοῦσαι τὴν σοφίαν Σολομῶνος καὶ ἰδοὺ πλεῖον Σολομῶνος ὧδε
verses.transliteration: basilissa notou egerthēsetai en tē krisei meta tēs geneas tautēs kai katakrinei autēn hoti ēlthen ek tōn peratōn tēs gēs akousai tēn sophian Solomōnos kai idou pleion Solomōnos hōde
verses.literal: The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with this generation and condemn it for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon and now One greater than Solomon is here
verses.literalPt: A rainha do meio-dia se levantará no dia do juízo com esta geração, e a condenará; porque veio dos confins da terra para ouvir a sabedoria de Salomão. E eis que está aqui quem é maior do que Salomão.

verses.original: Ὅταν δὲ τὸ ἀκάθαρτον πνεῦμα ἐξέλθῃ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου διέρχεται δι’ ἀνύδρων τόπων ζητοῦν ἀνάπαυσιν καὶ οὐχ εὑρίσκει
verses.transliteration: Hotan de to akatharton pneuma exelthē apo tou anthrōpou dierchetai di’ anydrōn topōn zētoun anapausin kai ouch heuriskei
verses.literal: When an unclean spirit comes out of a man it passes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it
verses.literalPt: E, quando o espírito imundo tem saído do homem, anda por lugares áridos, buscando repouso, e não o encontra.

verses.original: τότε λέγει Εἰς τὸν οἶκόν μου ἐπιστρέψω ὅθεν ἐξῆλθον καὶ ἐλθὸν εὑρίσκει σχολάζοντα καὶ σεσαρωμένον καὶ κεκοσμημένον
verses.transliteration: tote legei Eis ton oikon mou epistrepsō hothen exēlthon kai elthon heuriskei scholazonta kai sesarōmenon kai kekosmēmenon
verses.literal: Then it says I will return to the house I left On its return it finds the house vacant swept clean and put in order
verses.literalPt: Então diz: Voltarei para a minha casa, de onde saí. E, voltando, acha-a desocupada, varrida e adornada.

verses.original: τότε πορεύεται καὶ παραλαμβάνει μεθ’ ἑαυτοῦ ἑπτὰ ἕτερα πνεύματα πονηρότερα ἑαυτοῦ καὶ εἰσελθόντα κατοικεῖ ἐκεῖ καὶ γίνεται τὰ ἔσχατα τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐκείνου χείρονα τῶν πρώτων οὕτως ἔσται καὶ τῇ γενεᾷ ταύτῃ τῇ πονηρᾷ
verses.transliteration: tote poreuetai kai paralambanei meth’ heautou hepta hetera pneumata ponērotera heautou kai eiselthonta katoikei ekei kai ginetai ta eschata tou anthrōpou ekeinou cheirona tōn prōtōn houtōs estai kai tē genea tautē tē ponēra
verses.literal: Then it goes and brings with it . . . . . . seven other spirits more wicked than itself and they go in and dwell there And the final plight of that man is worse than the first So . . . will it be with this wicked generation
verses.literalPt: Então vai, e leva consigo outros sete espíritos piores do que ele e, entrando, habitam ali; e são os últimos atos desse homem piores do que os primeiros. Assim acontecerá também a esta geração má.

verses.original: Ἔτι δὲ αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος τοῖς ὄχλοις ἰδοὺ ἡ μήτηρ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ εἱστήκεισαν ἔξω ζητοῦντες αὐτῷ λαλῆσαι
verses.transliteration: Eti de autou lalountos tois ochlois idou hē mētēr kai hoi adelphoi autou heistēkeisan exō zētountes autō lalēsai
verses.literal: While Jesus was still speaking . . . to the crowds His mother and brothers stood outside wanting to speak to Him
verses.literalPt: E, falando ele ainda à multidão, eis que estavam fora sua mãe e seus irmãos, pretendendo falar-lhe.

verses.original: εἶπεν δέ τις αὐτῷ Ἰδοὺ ἡ μήτηρ σου καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοί σου ἔξω ἑστήκασιν ζητοῦντές σοι λαλῆσαι
verses.transliteration: eipen de tis autō Idou hē mētēr sou kai hoi adelphoi sou exō hestēkasin zētountes soi lalēsai
verses.literal: Someone told Him Look Your mother and - brothers are standing outside wanting to speak to You
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhe alguém: Eis que estão ali fora tua mãe e teus irmãos, que querem falar-te.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν τῷ λέγοντι αὐτῷ Τίς ἐστιν ἡ μήτηρ μου καὶ τίνες εἰσὶν οἱ ἀδελφοί μου
verses.transliteration: Ho de apokritheis eipen tō legonti autō Tis estin hē mētēr mou kai tines eisin hoi adelphoi mou
verses.literal: But Jesus replied . . . . . . . . . Who is My mother and who are My brothers
verses.literalPt: Ele, porém, respondendo, disse ao que lhe falara: Quem é minha mãe? E quem são meus irmãos?

verses.original: καὶ ἐκτείνας τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ εἶπεν Ἰδοὺ ἡ μήτηρ μου καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοί μου
verses.transliteration: kai ekteinas tēn cheira autou epi tous mathētas autou eipen Idou hē mētēr mou kai hoi adelphoi mou
verses.literal: Pointing . . . . . . . . . to His disciples He said Here are My mother and My brothers
verses.literalPt: E, estendendo a sua mão para os seus discípulos, disse: Eis aqui minha mãe e meus irmãos;

verses.original: ὅστις γὰρ ἂν ποιήσῃ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ Πατρός μου τοῦ ἐν οὐρανοῖς αὐτός μου ἀδελφὸς καὶ ἀδελφὴ καὶ μήτηρ ἐστίν
verses.transliteration: hostis gar an poiēsē to thelēma tou Patros mou tou en ouranois autos mou adelphos kai adelphē kai mētēr estin
verses.literal: For whoever . . . does the will of My Father in heaven is My brother and sister and mother
verses.literalPt: Porque, qualquer que fizer a vontade de meu Pai que está nos céus, este é meu irmão, e irmã e mãe.
